title: HistoryIndexService
responsibility: Builds the deterministic history index from source refs, registries, notes and evidence.

inputs.name: HistoryIndexService.constructor.root
inputs.description: Git repository whose source refs and evidence are read.

inputs.name: HistoryIndexService.build.out
inputs.description: Output directory for the portable index, revision files, media and catalog.

inputs.name: HistoryIndexService.build.limit
inputs.description: Maximum number of source revisions to include.

inputs.name: HistoryIndexService.build.legacy
inputs.description: Reader that returns legacy report entries using the history media writer.

inputs.name: compactRevision.result
inputs.description: Built revision whose complete detail has already been written.

inputs.name: compactRevision.events
inputs.description: Shared map used to reuse identical budget events.

inputs.name: storedSnapshots.out
inputs.description: History output directory containing saved revision details.

inputs.name: storedSnapshots.built
inputs.description: Revision summaries identifying the saved details to read.

inputs.name: activityDetails.out
inputs.description: History output directory containing saved revision details.

inputs.name: activityDetails.built
inputs.description: Revision summaries used to construct activity data.

outputs.name: HistoryIndexService.build
outputs.description: Writes a deterministic history index, per-revision details, media and catalog; returns output metadata and the index.

outputs.name: compactRevision
outputs.description: Projects a built revision for subsequent index aggregation and reuses equal budget events.

outputs.name: storedSnapshots
outputs.description: Yields saved registries in revision order for catalog indexing.

outputs.name: activityDetails
outputs.description: Returns per-revision explanation and impact data plus the newest registry owners.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Propagates Git, filesystem, parsing and legacy-reader failures.

test.title: history archives owned text from each commit, deduplicates it and states source gaps
